reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep Ocean
reading.passage: Bioluminescence, the production of light by living organisms, is a fascinating phenomenon commonly observed in deep ocean environments. Many deep-sea creatures, such as anglerfish and jellyfish, produce light through chemical reactions within their bodies. This adaptation serves multiple purposes: attracting prey, communicating with other organisms, and providing defense mechanisms against predators. Scientists estimate that approximately 90% of deep-sea organisms possess bioluminescent capabilities, making it one of nature's most remarkable survival strategies in extreme environments.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary purpose of bioluminescence in deep-sea creatures?
options: To attract prey, communicate, and defend against predators
To help them navigate through water
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'attracting prey, communicating with other organisms, and providing defense mechanisms against predators'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following organisms is mentioned as having bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'anglerfish and jellyfish'가 bioluminescence를 가진 생물의 예시로 제시되었습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about the prevalence of bioluminescence in deep-sea environments?
options: It is extremely rare among deep-sea creatures
Approximately 90% of deep-sea organisms possess this ability
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 부분에서 '약 90%의 심해 생물들이 생물발광 능력을 가지고 있다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made human life easier but less meaningful'? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시 (동의/비동의). 2-3개의 주요 이유를 간단히 언급. 예: 'I disagree with this statement because technology has enhanced both convenience and meaning in our lives.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유 전개. 기술이 업무 효율성을 증대시켜 더 의미 있는 활동에 시간을 할애할 수 있다는 점 설명. 구체적 예시 제시 (원격근무, 자동화 등).
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유 전개. 기술이 사람들 간의 연결을 가능하게 하여 관계와 공동체 의식을 강화한다는 점. 예시: 소셜 미디어, 온라인 커뮤니티, 원거리 교육 등.
structure.conclusion: 주요 주장 재강조. 기술은 올바르게 사용될 경우 삶을 더 의미 있게 만들 수 있다는 최종 의견 제시.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study alone, while others prefer to study in groups. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer studying in groups because...
One reason is that studying with others helps me...
Another advantage is that group study allows me to...
For example, when I study with friends...
In conclusion, I believe that group study is more beneficial for me.
sample_points: 그룹 스터디는 다양한 관점과 설명을 통해 더 깊은 이해를 가능하게 합니다. 친구들이 다른 방식으로 개념을 설명할 때 더 명확하게 이해할 수 있습니다.
협력적 학습은 동기부여와 책임감을 증대시킵니다. 함께 공부하는 것이 혼자 공부할 때보다 더 재미있고 효과적입니다. 또한 어려운 부분을 함께 해결할 수 있습니다.

listening.title: University Library Study Program
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I'm looking for information about the study programs offered at the library. Librarian: Of course! We offer several programs throughout the semester. We have quiet study zones for those who need concentration, collaborative study rooms for group projects, and specialized tutoring sessions for different subjects. Student: That sounds great! How do I register for the tutoring sessions? Librarian: It's quite simple. You can sign up online through our website or come to the front desk with your student ID. We offer tutoring in mathematics, sciences, languages, and humanities. Sessions are typically held three times a week. Student: Perfect! Do you charge any fees? Librarian: No, all our services are completely free for enrolled students. We also provide access to digital databases and online resources. Is there anything else you'd like to know? Student: No, that's very helpful. Thank you!

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To provide information about library study programs and services
To arrange a personal tutoring appointment
questions.explanation: 대화의 전반적인 내용은 학생이 도서관의 스터디 프로그램에 대한 정보를 요청하고, 사서가 다양한 서비스(조용한 스터디 존, 협력학습실, 튜터링 등)를 설명하는 것입니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, which subjects does the library provide tutoring for?
questions.explanation: 사서는 'We offer tutoring in mathematics, sciences, languages, and humanities'라고 명시적으로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: What does the student learn about the cost of library services?
options: Services are expensive and require membership fees
Tutoring costs money but other services are free
All services are completely free for enrolled students
There is a small registration fee
questions.explanation: 사서는 'No, all our services are completely free for enrolled students'라고 명확히 설명했습니다.
